title: Atlas M2.2 deterministic transfer challenge
purpose: Add one deterministic, local transfer challenge after successful maintenance reconfirmation, using existing authored transfer activities while preserving the promoted M2 memory schedule and all local/offline boundaries.
invariants: No database, store, storage namespace, state version or migration changes.
No content revision change; existing transfer|practice activities are consumed as authored.
LearningAction adds only attempt-transfer and ReasonCode adds only TRANSFER_AVAILABLE.
Transfer eligibility requires at least one successful admissible maintenance reconfirmation in the current validation cycle.
Each successful maintenance reconfirmation unlocks at most one subsequent transfer attempt.
Maintenance due outranks transfer and review-needed outranks both.
Transfer evidence is additive and never resets or extends the 1/3/7/21 memory schedule.
Incorrect or assisted transfer never erases prior independent validation.
Independent transfer success requires correct outcome and assistance none.
transfer-completed remains forbidden and no mastery/certification claim is introduced.
ObjectiveEvidence v1 remains unchanged; transfer uses a separate pure derived TransferEvidence v1 projection.
No backend, account, synchronization, runtime LLM/API, secret or network-required learning behavior.
requiredEvidence: Exact product diff stays within ATLAS-WP-005 allowed paths and contains no independent-QA files.
Existing promoted baseline, M1 and M2 developer suites remain green.
Developer tests prove transfer eligibility, one-attempt-per-reconfirmation, maintenance priority and review priority.
Developer tests prove correct unassisted success, assisted/incorrect non-credit and memory-schedule invariance.
No transfer recommendation exists without an authored transfer|practice activity.
Closed contracts reject unknown action/reason/fields and transfer-completed.
No storage migration and no runtime network dependency.
Two clean deterministic builds are byte-identical.
Strict visible desktop/mobile/keyboard regression remains green.
Exact product artifact is published for independent QA binding.
adversarialTests: Attempt transfer before first reconfirmation and require rejection/non-eligibility.
Attempt two transfers after one reconfirmation and require only the first opportunity.
Add a later successful reconfirmation and require exactly one new transfer opportunity.
Make maintenance due and require maintenance action instead of transfer.
Set review-needed and require correction/review instead of transfer.
Use assistance used or unknown and require no independent transfer success.
Use incorrect transfer and require prior validation/memory dueAt to remain intact.
Remove transfer activity and require no attempt-transfer recommendation.
Inject transfer-completed or unknown fields and require fail-closed behavior.
independentReview: Governor selection and frozen semantics are recorded on issue #203 before implementation.
QA-WP-016 is independently owned on a separate branch and may not repair product files.
Final QA PASS is forbidden until the exact product head and exact artifact are frozen and rebound.
Promotion and Pages repin remain accountable-human gated on the exact independently tested artifact.
nonGoals: New activity types or content revision changes
New reward economy, XP, rank, streak or dashboard
Backend, accounts, cloud synchronization or remote catalog
rollback: Revert ATLAS-WP-005 product changes. Promoted M2 state remains structurally valid because no storage migration, content revision or identity rewrite occurs.
